# Ardeno Studio

> Ardeno Studio is a Colombo, Sri Lanka web design and development studio building custom websites, booking systems, redesigns, and AI-assisted lead flows for Sri Lankan businesses and global clients.

## What Ardeno Studio does

Ardeno Studio builds premium custom-coded websites and browser-based digital systems. The studio focuses on first impression, mobile clarity, performance, conversion paths, security-ready launches, and post-launch support.

## Core services

- Premium Business Website: custom-coded responsive business websites with metadata, performance, and conversion basics included.
- Website Redesign Sprint: focused rebuilds for businesses whose current website feels outdated, unclear, slow, or weaker than the business.
- Booking and Order System: browser-based booking, ordering, and portal systems for restaurants, salons, service teams, clinics, events, and appointment-led businesses.
- AI Lead Assistant: secure website assistants that answer visitor questions, qualify leads, and guide users after hours.

## Frequently answered questions

### How much does a website from Ardeno cost?

Every project is scoped individually because every business is different. Pricing depends on complexity, custom features, content needs, integrations, and project goals. Ardeno Studio provides a clear custom quote after a discovery call.

### How long does it take to build a website?

A standard business website usually takes 2 to 4 weeks from kickoff to launch. More complex portals, ecommerce builds, booking systems, or custom web applications typically run 4 to 8 weeks.

### Who owns the website after it is built?

The client owns the website after final payment is made. Full ownership of the code and design passes to the client with no lock-in or licensing fees.

### Can Ardeno redesign an existing website?

Yes. Ardeno Studio audits what is working, identifies weak first impressions or conversion issues, and rebuilds the site from a stronger design, technical, and content foundation.
